channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Russia strikes Kyiv as three-day pause during US envoy visits ends
item.description: US envoy says 'encouraged' by talks as White House official told Reuters next steps to be announced in coming weeks.

item.title: Yemeni forces launch counteroffensive against Houthis, vow to retake Sanaa
item.description: Bid to take capital comes as clashes between Yemeni forces and Houthis intensify in provinces of al-Bayda and al-Jawf.

item.title: IAEA warns over Iran nuclear access as Western powers push UN referral
item.description: UN nuclear watchdog urges Iran to cooperate, as Western powers push to refer its nuclear file to the Security Council.

item.title: Iran war live: Qatar warns of ‘industrial catastrophe’ if crisis continues
item.description: An average of 10 ships transited Strait of Hormuz daily over past 10 days, the lowest level since May, Kpler data shows.

item.title: Houthis accuse Saudi Arabia of killing seven in Yemen prison air strike
item.description: Houthi-run media outlet released footage of destruction after alleged Saudi air strike on al-Hazm prison.

item.title: Oil prices surge as US-Iran strikes intensify in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Oil prices spike to six-week highs as US-Iran strikes disrupt traffic in the crucial Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Yemen fighting escalates as forces battle for Bab al-Mandeb Strait
item.description: Fighting is intensifying in Yemen as government-aligned forces launch counterattacks against the Iran-backed Houthis.

item.title: Syria’s Assad-era reactor configured for nuclear weapons: IAEA
item.description: UN watchdog says material from facility, bombed in 2007, now under IAEA safeguards.

item.title: The domestic armed threat facing Iran
item.description: External support for ethnic armed groups poses an escalating security threat to Iran, experts and state officials warn.

item.title: Flight recorders recovered from 'devastating' Amazon cargo plane crash
item.description: Five people were killed and five others seriously injured when the Boeing 767-300 overshot the runway at Miami International Airport.
